function members(address) view returns (bool active, bool isGuest)
function getTransaction(uint256) view returns (address proposer, uint256 amount, string description, bool executed, bool rejected, uint256 votesFor, uint256 votesAgainst, uint256 createdAt)
function joinFor(address user, uint256 nonce, bytes signature)
function requestExpenseFor(address user, uint256 amount, string desc, bool forceApproval, uint256 nonce, bytes signature) returns (uint256)
function voteFor(address voter, uint256 id, bool approve, uint256 nonce, bytes signature)
event Deposit(address indexed from, uint256 amount, uint256 newBalance)
event ExpenseExecuted(uint256 indexed txId, address indexed user, uint256 amount, string desc, uint256 newBalance)
event ApprovalRequested(uint256 indexed txId, address indexed user, uint256 amount, string desc, uint256 votesNeeded)
event Voted(uint256 indexed txId, address indexed voter, bool approve, uint256 votesFor, uint256 votesAgainst)
event ApprovalResolved(uint256 indexed txId, bool approved)
event MemberAdded(address indexed member, bool isGuest)
